# Drop

> Drop is a social website, iPhone app, and Android app for discovering live music, with a focus on EDM and electronic shows: raves, festivals, club nights, and concerts. Listings link out to the official ticketing page when the seller provides one. Available on the App Store and Google Play.

Drop is built in Colorado by Resonance Ventures LLC. Primary site: https://trydropapp.com

## Key facts

- Coverage starts in Denver, Colorado, and includes city guides for Denver, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, San Diego, Brooklyn, New York, Chicago, Dallas, Austin, Boston, Las Vegas, San Francisco, Houston, Phoenix, Atlanta, Cambridge, Washington, Miami, Detroit, Philadelphia, Columbus, and Charlotte.
- Drop is not a ticket seller, box office, promoter, or event organizer. Ticket purchases happen on the official seller's site (see the [Terms](https://trydropapp.com/terms)).
- Event, venue, and artist pages are listed in the entity sitemap: https://trydropapp.com/sitemap-entities.xml
- City × genre pages (e.g. https://trydropapp.com/genre?genre=House&city=Chicago) list real upcoming shows and are indexed only when a city has at least three in that genre.
- Knowledge bundle (Open Knowledge Format): https://trydropapp.com/okf/index.md
- Drop is free to download and use.

## Pages

- [Home](https://trydropapp.com/): what Drop does and live-music discovery
- [Denver EDM shows](https://trydropapp.com/city?city=Denver): Denver city guide
- [Events](https://trydropapp.com/events): browse live concerts, raves, festivals, and club nights by city, date, genre
- [Venues](https://trydropapp.com/venues): browse concert venues, clubs, and festival grounds by city
- [Artists](https://trydropapp.com/artists): browse artists with upcoming shows by city
- [For Promoters](https://trydropapp.com/promoters): list an event free on Drop
- [About](https://trydropapp.com/about): who builds Drop, why it exists
- [Download Drop for iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/drop-edm-events/id6790662825): App Store
- [Download Drop for Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.resonanceventures.drop): Google Play
- [Privacy Policy](https://trydropapp.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://trydropapp.com/terms)

## Guides

Source-checked guides (each cites its sources):

- [Denver EDM Venues: Every Room Worth Knowing](https://trydropapp.com/guides/denver-colorado-edm-venues): A fan's guide to Denver and Colorado EDM venues: Mission Ballroom, Fillmore, Ogden, Cervantes', Summit, Bluebird and more. Age rules, GA, bags. Oct 2026.
- [EDM Festival Calendar 2027: Confirmed Dates](https://trydropapp.com/guides/edm-festival-calendar-2027): Confirmed 2027 EDM festival dates, grouped by month, each checked on the festival's own site. Festivals still waiting on dates are flagged TBA.
- ["How to Budget for an EDM Festival (With a Worksheet)"](https://trydropapp.com/guides/festival-budgeting): "Plan your festival spend: ticket tiers and fees, payment plans, travel, lodging, food, water, merch and cashless payments, plus a simple worksheet."
- ["EDM Festival Packing List: What to Bring (and Skip)"](https://trydropapp.com/guides/festival-packing-list): "Festival packing list built from real EDC, Ultra and Decadence rules: bags, water, sun, earplugs, chargers and cashless. Checked Oct 2026."
- [Festival Safety Basics: Heat, Hearing, Friends, 911](https://trydropapp.com/guides/festival-safety-harm-reduction-basics): Plain festival and show safety: beat the heat, protect your ears, use a buddy, spot spiked drinks, know fentanyl and naloxone facts, and when to call 911.
- [How to Plan a Festival Day From the Set Times](https://trydropapp.com/guides/festival-set-time-planning): Set times dropped? Here is how to read overlaps, build a must-see list, leave walking buffers, schedule water and food, and keep a backup plan.
- [First Rave Guide: What to Expect and How to Stay Safe](https://trydropapp.com/guides/first-rave-guide): Going to your first rave, club night or festival? Here's what to expect, PLUR etiquette, hearing protection, hydration, age rules and how to get home.
- [Going Solo to a Festival or Show: A Safety Guide](https://trydropapp.com/guides/going-solo-to-a-festival): Going to a festival or show alone? Safety habits, how to meet people, a phone and meetup plan, lodging and rides home, and when to ask staff for help.
- [Red Rocks EDM Guide: Parking, Bags, Weather, Exit](https://trydropapp.com/guides/red-rocks-edm-guide): Going to an EDM show at Red Rocks? Parking, shuttles, bag rules, GA vs reserved, altitude, weather, what to pack and how to get out. As of Oct 2026.
- [Getting To and From Big Venues: Rideshare and Transit](https://trydropapp.com/guides/rideshare-transit-big-venues): How to reach Red Rocks, Ball Arena, Mission Ballroom and the Fillmore in Denver: shuttles, RTD, rideshare zones, surge pricing, and leaving smart.
